name: Wild West Wyoming 2026
information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). 

Go to our [Website](https://utahcubing.org/) to find upcoming Utah Cubing Association competitions! Here you can also find our Facebook group , Instagram page, and the Rockies Discord Server.
